name: bilibili-local-cache-manager-desktop
description: Bilibili local cache manager desktop client
author: BiliBiliLocalCacheManager contributors

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -s first "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:electron && vite build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux deb rpm --x64 --publish never
